era: 2019 itch.io: essentially the design it still has (white page, grey left column, Lato, red #fa5c5c accent, the same header and grids). Proven by 2019 Arquivo captures of the front page, browse, genre, jams, game and creator pages; the markup of the header, browse filters, tag row and game pages is the same as today. Only YouTube promos and the devlog "View all posts" link are later.
